author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
#smallpoems
dragon drawn chariots
chasing
firefish in
rivers of knowledge
drawn
from endless wells
of ignorance.

sewn together,
stiched in time by an
arrow piercing the eye of wayward gods
wreathed,
twisted in folds
will the flesh of the hunt
serve the sullied
at a feast of the righteous?

Can those who hear
the Way on the river
beating upon our shore
a hundred time over
actually know it's sound?
